# ECoMAPr

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Repository containing the documentation and workflow code related to work package 2 of the [ECoMAP project](https://betweenthefjords.w.uib.no/ecomap/).

## Installation

You can install the development version of ECoMAPr from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with the following code:

``` r
# Install the INLA dependancy for the ECoMAPr package (we are working to remove
# this dependancy)
if(!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install(c("graph", "Rgraphviz"), dep = TRUE)
install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"), INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep = TRUE)
# Install the ECoMAPr package
devtools::install_github("NINAnor/ECoMAPr")
```

## Development environment

The repository includes a Pixi environment with R and development tools. Install it with:

```bash
pixi install
```

Run the second setup step for R dependencies not available through conda-forge:

```bash
pixi run setup-r-dependencies
```

Run an R script with `Rscript`:

```bash
pixi run Rscript path/to/script.R
```

Radian is optional; it starts an interactive R console:

```bash
pixi run radian
```

The repository's Prek hooks include R formatting and other checks. Install the git hooks or run the checks manually:

```bash
pixi run prek install
pixi run prek --all-files
```
